text:
Lisi, you will find no coolness in shade, for with two burning lights you bring dog-day heat to shadow that could warm the Alps.


These places have made Daphne forget her ancient modesty and reserve; she who fled one sun feels safe from your two singular suns.


But seeing him divided in your eyes so he may dwell in you twice, she sees him twice defeated in you.


And she feels you hate him as she did, for you have withdrawn to her shade and trunk the rays you deny and offer him.

translation.title: Lisi, You Will Find No Coolness in Shade
